public_rationale: CNBC reported that OpenAI burned USD 8 billion in 2025. That supports the firm 2025 threshold at the reported precision. This outcome applies only to that component. The nearly USD 1 trillion estimate for 2030 was expressly hedged and is not scored as a firm forecast or an additional condition that must be fulfilled.
limitations: The result relies on reputable reporting of private financial information, not a published audited cash-flow statement.
The rounded figure cannot establish whether unrounded burn was marginally above or below USD 8 billion.
No outcome is assigned to the qualified 2030 estimate or the surrounding causal rhetoric.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI will burn $8 billion or more in 2025 and, if his estimates are right, nearly a trillion dollars by 2030.

statement.excerpt: ChatGPT’s popularity — and OpenAI’s hunger for endless amounts of compute — have created the illusion of demand due to the sheer amount of capacity required to keep their services operational, all so they can burn $8 billion or more in 2025 and, if my estimates are right, nearly a trillion dollars by 2030.

our_interpretation: The firm, scored forecast is at least USD 8 billion of cash burn during calendar 2025.
Burn means net cash consumed by the business, not gross expenditure, financing raised, annualized revenue, or accounting net loss.
The 2030 amount is expressly qualified by if my estimates are right. It is a hedged estimate and is excluded from the scored forecast, preserving the caveat's effect.
The caveat is not an independently observable antecedent whose occurrence can be tested. No conditional-forecast score is assigned to the 2030 estimate.
The surrounding illusion-of-demand characterization is not part of the supplied normalized monetary forecast being scored.
Amounts are assessed at the precision of credible financial reporting; no unreported decimal precision is invented.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable reporting of realized calendar-2025 net cash burn of USD 8 billion or more.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable reporting of realized calendar-2025 net cash burn below USD 8 billion.
